items.item: Built Graphitra, a visual knowledge-graph platform with interactive canvases, relationship visualization, A*-based orthogonal routing, obstacle avoidance, graph versioning (snapshots, branches, diffs, merges), Wikidata and Fandom integration, and AI-driven graph authoring
